messages.content: 我應該混合哪些顏色才能得到特定的色調？

function.name: color_converter_RGB_to_Pantone
function.description: Convert a color from RGB (Red, Green, Blue) format to Pantone. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

red.description: The red component of the RGB color, ranging from 0 to 255.

green.description: The green component of the RGB color, ranging from 0 to 255.

blue.description: The blue component of the RGB color, ranging from 0 to 255.

message.content:
請問您想要得到哪一種顏色？  
- 您可以直接給出 RGB 值（例如 R=120, G=200, B=150）  
- 或者提供 Pantone 編號  
- 也可以簡單描述顏色（如「淡藍色」或「深紅色」）  

有了目標顏色後，我就能幫您計算混合比例，並告訴您需要混合哪些顏色。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "我應該混合哪些顏色才能得到特定的色調？" They want to know which colors to mix to get a specific hue. We need to ask for the target color or hue. We can ask them to provide the desired color in RGB or Pantone or a description. Then we can use the color conversion function to convert RGB to Pantone. But the function only converts RGB to Pantone. We might need to ask for the target color in RGB. Then we can provide mixing suggestions. We can also ask for the desired color in Pantone. But the function only converts RGB to Pantone. So we can ask for the target color in RGB. Then we can convert to Pantone. Then we can give mixing instructions. We can also ask for the color mixing method: paint, digital, etc. But the user didn't specify. We can ask for more details. So we should ask: "請告訴我您想要得到的顏色是什麼？您可以提供RGB值或Pantone編號，或者描述顏色。"

We should respond in Chinese.
